title: Keyturn Trip Booking Desk Note: Bought Top-Ups of Included Miles on a Reservation
content:
A guest who asks for more included miles part way through a Keyturn Trip Booking reservation is granted a top-up of included miles on that reservation. The grant is booked against the reservation's mileage record as a purchased top-up made part way through the trip, so that the miles it adds stay separable from the allowance the reservation was granted when it was confirmed and from any miles an extension brings. Once it is booked, the reservation's mileage record carries the added miles and the guest can see them among the included miles granted to the trip.

### Making the call

The grant is made with the desk's own tool `grant_mileage_topup_0373887d`, which is unlocked and then called by the agent. It books a single grant against the reservation's mileage record, dated today.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `booking_id` | The reference number of the trip reservation the miles are added to, read from the trip booking lookup before the call. | Id class. |
| `customer_id` | The member reference number of the guest holding that reservation, read from the member profile lookup before the call. | Id class. |
| `granted_miles` | How many included miles this top-up adds. | Fixed-format class: whole miles, signed, positive on a grant, with no decimal part and no thousands separator. |

`booking_id` and `customer_id` are both identifiers of the Id class. `granted_miles` is the quantity of included miles the grant adds, written in whole miles.

### Return

The call returns a confirmation sentence naming the reference number of the new mileage record, the reservation it was booked against and the miles added, in whole miles. Receiving that sentence means the grant is on the reservation's mileage record; anything else means no miles were added.
